title: Keep stale policy obligations until deliberate supersession
preconditions: A separate criterion has a current policy requiring all three kinds and otherwise current covering cases.

steps.action: Change the criterion statement while preserving its identity; inspect the old policy, then append a policy pinned to the new revision that explicitly supersedes the old one.
steps.expected_result: The old policy is stale, all required kinds remain required and the criterion stays uncovered; the new policy restores current policy linkage.

expected_result: Keep stale policy obligations until deliberate supersession.
